subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted workspace-agent discovery, or keep agent registration explicit through existing config/RPC workflows?
rationale: The request adds new config, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, and live routing semantics that repo policy says need maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Keep explicit registration
options.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete`, and leave external discovery to docs or operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

options.title: Design trusted discovery
options.body: Define a core discovery contract with trusted roots, precedence, validation, reload semantics, and security proof before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete`, and leave external discovery to docs or operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current source-history signal on the central agent config and gateway agent management paths.
